messages.help: Orbit's help. Walk with n, s, e, w, ne, nw, se, sw, up and down; look lists the exits, and way to the cantina gives the steps. Help from the station: help moving, help talking, help work, help money, help shops, help ships, help casino, help progress. Orbit itself: remind me (a Hariku reminder before the next event), help settings, connect, quit (leave Orbit), status, repeat (the last message again). From Aruna, start with orbit: orbit north, orbit say hello.
messages.help_settings: Orbit's settings, typed in the game: voices off or on (players' own voices), my lines off or on (your own words in your character voice), names off or on (a player's name before their words), speech off or on (reading messages aloud), ambience off or on, ambience volume 30, sounds off or on, effects volume 60, other sounds off, ignore Budi, unignore Budi, ignored (the list), my voice 1 to 10 or my voice auto (the voice others hear for you), settings (the Preferences page). Closing the window keeps you connected in the background; quit leaves Orbit.

messages.note_character: Your character on this server: {name}, {job}. The name and job boxes are only used the first time you join a server.
messages.note_first: The name (3 to 20 letters and digits) and the job are used the first time you join; after that, the server remembers your character.
messages.note_quick: In the game you can also type: voices off, speech off, ambience off, sounds off, effects volume 50, ignore Budi, unignore Budi, my voice 3, settings, status, quit.
messages.note_voices: Each player's words are read by one of Hariku Voice's voices of your language: the one they chose (my voice 1 to 10: the same number is always the same voice on this computer) or one picked from their name. Your own words are spoken in your voice too, and a player's name comes first in Hariku Voice's usual voice ("Budi:"). The station's messages are read by Hariku Voice's usual voice. With fewer than two such voices, everything is read by your usual voice. Edge Voices, from the Extension Store, adds two Indonesian and many English voices (they send the text to Microsoft).
messages.note_privacy: Orbit connects only when you open it, press Connect or give it a command (or when Hariku starts, if you ask it to). The server keeps your character (name, job, description, credits, things, progress) and a hash of a secret made on this computer (no password, no email). Chat is passed on to the players who hear it and is not stored. Your settings and ignored players stay on this computer.
messages.voices_few: Hariku Voice has fewer than two voices in your language, so every player sounds the same. For voices of their own, get Edge Voices or Piper Voices from the Extension Store.
